title: Delegation, Roles, Authority, Communication & Succession
objective: Deliver one bounded read-only projection for explicit visible organizational roles, delegations, communication routes and succession plans, including explicit owner-backed organizational-authority scope references, while keeping canonical Organization/Faction/Relationship/Reputation, Character, Project/time/context and Permission/visibility owners authoritative and preventing descriptive hierarchy from becoming system permission or autonomous command authority.

The deterministic comparator confirmed identical RED receipts across both lanes.

resolved_contract.record_rule: Only explicit visible owner-referenced records with organization/subject, kind, owner, profile/context, provenance and visibility references participate. ODL-04 does not infer records from title, rank, hierarchy, ODL-02 pressure, ODL-03 politics, counts, money, location or elapsed time.
resolved_contract.resolution_rule: After visibility filtering, a kind resolves only when compatible visible observed records agree on one semantic tuple under one profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown remains unknown; incompatible-only remains incompatible; divergent semantic/profile/context tuples or mixed observed/incompatible evidence remains conflict. Canonical-owner contradictions are never auto-resolved.
resolved_contract.authority_scope_rule: Organizational-authority scope is descriptive owner-backed evidence only and never grants system permission, executable action authority, canonical ownership, autonomous command authority or permission bypass.
resolved_contract.delegation_rule: No role assignment, delegation create/revoke/execute, delegated action execution or inferred organizational authority is performed.
resolved_contract.communication_rule: No message is sent, no communication channel is created or mutated, and hidden endpoints are never revealed.
resolved_contract.succession_rule: No leadership replacement or succession event is triggered and no campaign time is advanced.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized role, delegation, hierarchy/authority-scope, communication, succession, relationship, profile/context, provenance and advisory evidence is filtered before states, counts, summaries, search, provenance, receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality remains undisclosed.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-04 persistence, duplicate owner/relationship/permission/succession ledger or migration 0022.
